question: 最近90天（2026年6月14日至9月12日）内，日均销售额最高的5个商品分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与日均销售额）
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_date), 2) AS daily_avg_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-06-14' AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY daily_avg_revenue DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
pred_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal) / 90.0, 2) AS daily_avg_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-14' AND '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY daily_avg_sales DESC LIMIT 5
